text: Build cutover complete: one mvpa crossProject remains; mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset, and mvpa-spatial definitions, aliases, aggregate entries, compileAll/testAll entries, artifact names, package imports, and example dependencies are removed. sbt reload resolves the acyclic graph; atlas/workflow examples compile and test against mvpaJVM; live module docs describe one artifact.
